study_identification_part.si_4_title: Structural brain abnormalities and aggressive behaviour in schizophrenia: Mega-analysis of data from 2095 patients and 2861 healthy controls via the ENIGMA consortium

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Schizophrenia Working Group of the ENIGMA consortium; pooled data from 20 member sites.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Data came from the Schizophrenia Working Group of the Enhancing Neuroimaging Genetics through Meta-Analysis (ENIGMA) consortium... Twenty member sites contributed data to the current study."

answer.ENIGMA: healthy controls used to build normative models; patients used to quantify deviations and test associations with aggression

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative modelling used to compute individual-level deviation z-scores from healthy controls, then related to aggressive behaviour in patients.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Sites acquired T1-weighted and diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging scans in a total of 2095 patients with schizophrenia and 2861 healthy controls... normative modelling was used to calculate how much patients deviated (in z-scores) from healthy controls at the individual level."

model-1.model-name: structural MRI and diffusion MRI normative models

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Healthy controls reported overall for the pooled ENIGMA sample; no train/validation split described.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Sites acquired T1-weighted and diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging scans in a total of 2095 patients with schizophrenia and 2861 healthy controls."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Healthy control age reported for the overall sample only.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "Overall, the mean age of patients was 35 years (SD = 12) and that of healthy controls was also 35 years (SD = 13)."

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Female counts inferred from total healthy controls (2861) and reported male count (1404).
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "The proportion of men was higher in patients (n = 1391, 66%) than in healthy controls (n = 1404, 49%)."
